scenes.title: Why do we yawn?
scenes.text: Why do we yawn when we are tired?

scenes.speaker: mel
scenes.text: I thought it was because we need more oxygen.

scenes.title: Scientists are not sure
bullets: Oxygen idea does not hold up
scenes.text: That old idea does not hold up. Scientists think yawning may cool the brain or help us wake up.
You feel tired, you yawn, and you feel a little more alert.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: And yes, yawns are catchy. Did you yawn just now?
Follow for a new why every day.
